title: PDRVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model with Physical Dynamics Representations
abstract: arXiv:2610.37381v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vision--Language--Action (VLA) models generate robot actions from visual observations and language instructions, but their understanding of physical dynamics remains limited. Video world models can capture scene dynamics, yet generating future videos introduces high latency into the control loop. We introduce PDRVLA, whose lightweight Physical Dynamics Module extracts physical tokens from vision--language features to condition action generation without online video generation. The module learns through direct prediction of future RGB, depth, and optical-flow features, with auxiliary supervision through a frozen pretrained video world model. Training relies entirely on publicly available data, expanded through human-to-robot synthesis, subtask annotation, and embodied chain-of-thought (ECoT) annotation. Across four simulation benchmarks, PDRVLA achieves success rates of 99.3% on LIBERO, 89.9% on LIBERO-Plus, 93.6% on RoboTwin~2.

translated_title: PDRVLA：具有物理动力学表征的视觉-语言-动作模型
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型能够根据视觉观测和语言指令生成机器人动作，但其对物理动力学的理解仍然有限。视频世界模型可以捕捉场景动态，但生成未来视频会给控制回路带来较高的延迟。我们提出了 PDRVLA，其轻量级的物理动力学模块从视觉-语言特征中提取物理 token 来条件化动作生成，而无需在线视频生成。该模块通过直接预测未来的 RGB、深度和光流特征进行学习，并借助冻结的预训练视频世界模型提供辅助监督。训练完全依赖公开可用的数据，并通过人-机器人视频合成、子任务标注和具身思维链（ECoT）标注进行扩充。在四个仿真基准测试中，PDRVLA 在 LIBERO 上达到 99.3% 的成功率，在 LIBERO-Plus 上达到 89.9%，在 RoboTwin 2 上达到 93.6%。
tldr: PDRVLA 提出一种轻量级物理动力学模块，通过预测未来 RGB、深度和光流特征来学习物理表征，在无需在线视频生成的情况下显著提升了视觉-语言-动作模型的机器人操作性能。
